I farm 4.1 mu here in Quzhou. My family is big — 7 mouths — but two of my sons work in the city, so it is mostly me and my wife in the field, plus the children come help during picking.

Let me think about my land this year. Cotton is my main crop, I have done it for decades. I will put 2 mu into cotton. Then I still do the wheat-maize double crop on 1.5 mu like my neighbors — wheat in winter, maize after harvest. The last 0.6 mu I keep for stevia, the company comes to buy the dry leaves and it gives some cash.

**Cotton (2 mu):** I will plant improved Bt cotton seed, the kind the dealer in town sells. Last year the bollworm was not too bad because of this seed. Before planting I will plough and put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer per mu — that is about 50 kg — which gives me maybe 15 kg N, 8 kg P, 8 kg K. Then at flowering I top dress one bag of urea per mu, another 10 kg N. Cotton drinks a lot of water, I will water 4 times from my well. Bollworm and aphids — I spray maybe 6 times through the season, cannot skip this or the bolls are ruined. I expect about 230 kg seed cotton per mu if the weather is normal.

**Wheat (1.5 mu):** I plant the wheat my neighbor Lao Wang uses, Jimai variety, it does well here. Plough before sowing in October. I put 40 kg compound fertilizer as base — about 12 kg N, 6 kg P, 5 kg K — then in spring when it greens up I spread 15 kg urea, that is about 7 more kg N. Two waterings — one before winter, one at jointing. I spray twice, once for aphids, once for the rust. Should get around 450 kg per mu.

**Maize (1.5 mu, after wheat):** Summer maize, no time to plough, I just use the rotary machine and plant. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or similar, whatever the dealer has fresh. About 35 kg compound at sowing and 20 kg urea at big trumpet stage — total 16 kg N, 5 kg P, 4 kg K. Water twice if the rains are poor. Spray once for the borer. Around 550 kg per mu.

**Stevia (0.6 mu):** The company tells us what to do but I follow my own hand too. Transplant the seedlings in spring. Put 40 kg compound fertilizer per mu plus 15 kg urea split in two times — about 14 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. It needs water in the dry weeks, 4 times at least. Spray 3 times, the leaves must be clean or the company refuses them. Dry leaf about 250 kg per mu.

I would rather put a little extra fertilizer than be short — one bad year and my grandchildren eat less. Fertilizer money I can recover, lost yield I cannot.
